ruleValidation.requirement: per family: at least 3 distinct held-out target pairs, 2 independent root pairs, zero wrong winners, zero decisive predictions of close fights

tradeoffValidation.requirement: per directional mode: at least 50 independent original-engine and 5 corrected-engine held-out targets, zero wrong predictions in either stratum; disable any family with a known counterexample

twoSidedValidation.requirement: per family: at least 3 distinct corrected-engine held-out target pairs, 2 independent direct roots, zero wrong winners and zero close fights predicted decisively
